Subject: Launch Update and October 8 Staging Demo

Hi Avery,

The tentative October 8 production launch will not proceed as planned. Security review is now expected to complete October 12 at the earliest, and release requires completed approval. The review may also identify remediation needs, so no new production date is authorized yet.

The team remains focused on launch readiness while Nia completes the security review. We can still hold a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data.

Please confirm whether you would like to proceed with the October 8 staging demo. We will provide a production launch update once the security review and any required remediation are complete.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
